Starts the level: resets the stack, waits for the bottom of the screen and blanks it, selects VIC-II bank 1, unpacks the picture (colour at $D800, screen at $5C00, bitmap at $6000) from $9970, points the raster call at raster_bottom ($810B) and sets the VIC-II from the list after the call.
The high byte of the JSR to unpack_inline.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $9970 ($9970), 4494 bytes long.
The packed picture's length, 4,494 bytes.
Then the raster call goes to raster_bottom and the VIC-II list is written.

Text goes to the bitmap at $6000, the progress $0600 = 0, the flare lists cleared and the object tables linked (flares_clear), the clock started (clock_init), the objects made (objects_init); then the screen comes on.

Once every two frames, until the level ends (level_over): Ripley, Newt, the aliens, the Queen, firing and the flares, then all eight objects moved and animated and the sprites sorted (sprites_sort). After the first frame: the clock, firing again, the locator, the flares, the lift doors, the minutes notice and the explosions.
The level is over: waits 165 frames; unless Ripley has escaped (progress 6) the level is lost ($0203 = 0); then stage_complete.
Carry set when the level is over: Ripley has escaped (progress 6), the aliens have worn her down in this room ($060C = 0), or the clock has reached 00:00.
The raster call at line $FB: level_frame, all sprites in front, random, and the next call at line $64 (raster_mid).
At line $64: the sprites' priority from $047F, so those marked go behind the scenery below this line; the next call at line $FB.
Named by the trainer of level 6, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of raster_mid's STA $D012.
The RTS of raster_mid; named by the trainer of level 6, which pokes here when that level is loaded.

Chooses the five objects to show beside Ripley and Newt: in the lift room ($56) the flare and the doors, in the Queen's chamber ($C3) the Queen alone, and only in progress 3; elsewhere the flare and the two aliens; sorts them by y and hands their parts out to the eight sprite slots ($045B).
Named by the trainer of level 4, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of sprites_sort's STA $84.
The low byte of the sprite slot the parts go to, in the STA here (sprites_sort writes it, from $045B on).
The high byte of that STA's address; then the next part's number, until the object's parts are handed out.

Draws room X: its view from room_map: the doorway bits, plus 16 with bit 5; a special room (bit 4) has view 1 (the APC's room $BE), 2 (the lift room $56) or else 16 (the Queen's chamber). A test for $E1 there can never match, then the four quarter pieces with draw_char_block, at $6000, $6058, $6780 and $67D8, with the screen blank while they are drawn and coloured after.
A JMP to the next byte, left from editing.
Blanks the view (view_colour), then for each quarter sets draw_char_block's arguments from the view's piece: font, character list and bitmap address.
draw_char_block with the arguments written into the bytes after the call.
The high byte of draw_quarter's JSR.
draw_char_block's font address, low byte (written by room_draw).
The font address's high byte.
The character list's address, low byte.
The character list's high byte.
The bitmap address, low byte.
The bitmap address's high byte; then 11 characters by 6 rows (the bytes at $82E4).
The quarter's size: 11 characters by 6 rows.
The RTS of draw_quarter.
Colours the view's 22 columns by 12 rows of screen and colour RAM: 0 (blank) when entered here, $CB and $0F when entered at $82EC.
Inside view_colour's screen fill, the STA to row 11; named by a stale reference.

The fire delay $0604 (6, 7 on NTSC), 99 rounds ($0605) shown, the eight objects made (obj_types), Ripley in the lift room ($56) at x $3C, y $1A facing near, her gun flash, the two aliens hidden, the doors at their places, the flare's colour; then the lift room drawn (room_enter).
Named by the trainer of level 1, which lies here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of the LDY #$04 before it.
Named by the trainer of level 1, which lies here when that level is loaded; in this level a JSR to part_frames_set (entered at $0F00) for Ripley's body.
Named by the trainer of level 1 (the third byte of its JMP); in this level the operand of the JSR $0F00.

Ripley, while the aliens have not worn her down, once the doors are open and before progress 5: the joystick (joy_dirs) sets her facing (unless fire is held, ripley_face) and her way; she walks within the room's floor (floor_limits) and through its doorways into the next room. Walking animates her; standing shows her first frame. On every fourth step of her walk sfx_crash sounds, her footstep, and her body bobs down a unit.
Her animation runs backwards when her way is against her facing.
start_effect's argument: $3526 (sfx_crash).
Then Ripley's body offset down: 1 on a fourth step, else 0.
Behind the scenery ($0449 bit 6) while her y is $34-$3F.

The floor's edges at Ripley's y, for the perspective: left $84 and right $83 (fixed in the lift room), and when her y is level with the side doorways ($1D-$3F) how far she may go into them ($85, $86).
Right: through the right doorway into the next room (room + 1, entering at the left), else up to the right edge; speed $00D8 a frame (216/256 of a unit).
Left: through the left doorway (room - 1), else to the left edge.
Near (down the screen): through the near doorway at y $60 (room + 16, entering at the top, at x $2C in the Queen's chamber), else down to y $3F.
Far (up the screen): through the far doorway at y 3 (room - 16, entering at y $5D), else up to the back wall; in the lift room only to y $1A.
Turns Ripley to face a new way ($060A, left and right first) and starts its walking animation.

Fire held, with rounds left and Ripley able to fight: her gun flash shows for one pass in every $0604, one round is spent ($0605, decimal) and shown, sfx_burst, and the shot hits the nearest alien in line (shot_hit). Not while the aliens have worn her down.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded: the operand of fire's SBC #$01, the round each shot spends.
start_effect's argument: $34AF (sfx_burst).
Then the hit test (shot_hit).

Entering a room: sprites off while it is drawn, the room drawn, a flare shown if one was dropped here (flare_show), aliens placed (aliens_enter), Ripley's strength $060C back to 16; Newt is placed in her room ($C1) until found, or kept with Ripley after. Then progress: entering the Queen's chamber in progress 2 wakes the Queen (queen_place, progress 3); the room past it ($B3) moves progress 3 to 4; going back ($D3) makes it 2 again.
Named by the trainer of level 3, which writes an LDA here when that level is loaded; in this level the offset of a branch in room_enter's progress tests.

Each of two aliens appears in the room with a chance that grows with the room's number ($40 + half the room, out of 256), the second only in rooms with bit 5 of room_map: at a random x ($20-$37) and y ($1E-$3D), with two hits to kill, walking for 30 to 61 passes before its first pause. None in the lift room or the Queen's chamber.
The chance, written by aliens_enter.
Named by the trainer of level 3, which writes an LDA here when that level is loaded; in this level the high byte of aliens_enter's STA $0613,X.
Bit 5 of the room's map byte, written here: 0 ends the loop after the first alien.
No aliens: both $FF and the count $060E 0.

For each alien shown: gone when dead and its animation is over; otherwise it heads for Ripley (alien_toward), stopping when it touches her, with pauses (the timer $0615 counts down while it walks and up while it waits), within the room's floor (alien_limits) and its doorways; speed $00A2 a frame, slower than Ripley. One pass in 128, sfx_alarm.
Named by the trainer of level 6, which writes $AD here; in this level aliens_move's LDA #$00.
Named by the trainer of level 6, a second $AD; in this level the operand of aliens_move's STA $8D.
Named by the trainer of level 6, a third $AD; in this level aliens_move's ADC #$01.
start_effect's argument: $3582 (sfx_alarm).
For the alien: walking animates it, standing shows its first frame; behind the scenery while its y is $34-$3F; then the next alien.
The floor's edges at the alien's y, like floor_limits.
The alien moves right, to the right edge or into the doorway.
The alien moves left.
The alien moves near.
Named by the trainer of level 2, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level alien_near's CMP #$3F.
The alien moves far.
The way from the alien to Ripley (alien_dirs, by the signs and which distance is greater); 0 when it touches her (less than 6 across and 4 down), which takes one from her strength $060C.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded: the operand of alien_toward's SBC #$01, the strength each touch takes.
Turns the alien to face its way and sets its two parts' animations and the head's offset.
The facing's number, written by alien_face into this LDY: the head animation and offset for it.
When the alien's head animation has stopped, starts another, chosen at random.
Puts Newt in her room, at x $2C, y $15, standing.

Once found (progress 2 or more), Newt follows Ripley at her speed (newt_toward), stopping close to her, within the floor (newt_limits). In the lift room, when she reaches the back (y below $1C), progress goes up by one and the doors start to close.
The floor's edges at Newt's y.
Newt moves right.
Newt moves left.
Newt moves near.
Newt moves far; in the lift room she walks in to the back.
The way from Newt to Ripley (newt_dirs); 0 when within 3 across and 2 down.
Named by the trainer of level 4, which writes $BD here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of newt_toward's ROL $8F.
Turns Newt to face her way and starts its animation (newt_anim).
Moves Newt one step into the room she has followed Ripley into, off the doorway's edge.
Named by the trainer of level 4, which writes an RTS here when that level is loaded; in this level the low byte of newt_enter's LDA $0256.
Places the Queen (object 6) at x $2C, y $2E with her five parts and their animations (queen_parts, queen_anims).
The part count, written by queen_place.

In progress 3: the Queen's parts flicker at random; she moves at half a unit a frame towards Ripley's x and y (her y held to $10-$4F), or to x $18 or $40 while Ripley fires sideways; within 2 below her and 10 across, Ripley is lost ($060C = 0). Now and then, sfx_alarm.
Named by the trainer of level 2, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level queen_move's LDA $0605.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here: the STA $060C that loses Ripley to the Queen.
start_effect's argument for the Queen's cry: $3582 (sfx_alarm).
The RTS of queen_move.

The clock: 17:00 ($061C minutes, $061B seconds, decimal), a second every three ticks of $0209; eight flares ($0622); the doors' wait $063B (30); the explosions' countdown $061E = 5 and the first explosion's time.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of clock_init's LDA #$08 (the flares).
The shot along Ripley's facing: of the aliens within 3 of her line, the nearest ahead of her loses a hit ($0617); with none left it dies (animations $10 and $11).

The space bar ($0221 = $20) drops a flare where Ripley stands, if she has flares left and none lies in this room, not in the Queen's chamber: the room and x, y go in the lists at $CD00, $CE00 and $CF00, one flare comes off the panel (flare_lo, flare_hi) and the flare shows.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of flare_drop's CPX #$08, the end of the list search.
Shows the flare dropped in this room, if any (from the lists), behind the scenery when its y is $34-$3E; otherwise hides it.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level the operand of flare_show's CPX #$08, the end of the list search.

The lift's doors (object 5): after the wait $063B they run their animation, opening at the start and closing in progress 5. When it has stopped, progress 0 becomes 1 (Ripley may move) and 5 becomes 6 (escaped).
Prints the rounds left ($0605) as two digits (rounds_text).
Every three ticks of $0209 the clock goes down a second (decimal), and the time is printed (clock_text); it stops at 00:00.
Named by the trainer of level 5, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this level clock_tick's SBC #$01.
Prints the clock: minutes and seconds as digits into clock_text, with print_wide.

When the clock reaches the next time in blast_secs and blast_mins (16:43, 12:52, 8:25, 5:37, 2:11), sfx_hiss_short and the screen shakes for 28 passes. At 00:00 the last: sfx_blast, sprites off, and for 165 frames the screen shakes while 256 random bytes of the bitmap a frame are cleared; then the screen goes off.
start_effect's argument: $3843 (sfx_hiss_short).
Then the next explosion's time and 28 passes of shaking.
No shake: the fine scrolls back to 0 across and 3 down.
start_effect's argument: $38EF (sfx_blast).
The final blast: 165 frames of shaking while the picture is cleared away.
The low byte of the bitmap address the blast clears, written at random.
Its high byte, random within $60-$7F.
Sets both fine scrolls at random.

Until Newt is found: the range locator's distance and direction from Ripley to Newt. Each room is 10 units each way and a unit is 9 of x or y; the distance is about half of twice the greater plus the lesser. At distance 0, with no aliens in the room and progress 1, Newt is found (progress 2). It shows the distance (99 flashing when it is 100 or more) and one or two compass letters (locator_text).
The direction: compared with tan_22 to tell a straight bearing from a diagonal, then N or S by the sign of the rows and W or E by the columns.
When the seconds reach 00, prints "nn MIN. TO REACH SAFE DISTANCE." with sfx_chord, and clears it after 84 passes.
start_effect's argument: $3958 (sfx_chord).
Then the notice is printed.
